title: Find a Tote by Entering a Location Number or Tote Number on the Container Selection Screen
summary: Use the Container Selection screen to locate a tote by typing a location number or tote number and then selecting the rack or AGV where the tote is located (when that tote/location exists in the system).
when_to_use: When you need to find where a tote is located in the system by using a location number or tote number, and you want the screen to identify the associated rack or AGV.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Use the Container Selection screen to enter the location number or tote number and select the rack/AGV shown by the screen.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the Container Selection screen (HMI)
Ability to enter a location number and/or tote number

access_required: Access to the Container Selection screen (HMI)
system_preconditions: The tote/location you are searching for must exist in the system for the screen to identify the rack or AGV.

visual_references.description: Container Selection screen frame showing the Container Selection UI and the instruction that you can find a tote by typing a location number and selecting the rack or AGV where it is located (if it’s in the system).

steps.title: Open the Container Selection screen (totes/containers)
steps.purpose: Get to the screen that supports searching for a tote by location number or tote number.
steps.instruction: Open the Container Selection screen for totes/containers on the HMI.
steps.expected_result: The Container Selection screen is displayed with the tote/container view.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Container Selection UI elements for totes/containers (including the area where you can select a rack/AGV and where the screen supports tote/container lookup).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot access the Container Selection screen or the screen does not load.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/transcript: “Container Selection … You can also find a tote by typing the … location number in and selecting the rack or AGV it’s located on if it’s in the system.”

steps.title: Type the desired location number into the location field
steps.purpose: Provide the location number so the screen can identify the rack or AGV where the tote is located (if present).
steps.instruction: Type the desired location number into the location number input field on the Container Selection screen.
steps.expected_result: The entered location number is used by the screen for the tote lookup (i.e., the screen can show the rack or AGV where the tote is located if it exists in the system).
steps.healthy_condition: After entering the location number, the screen is able to present rack/AGV location information for that tote (when it exists).
steps.failure_condition: No rack/AGV location is shown for the entered location number.

actions.label: Enter location number
actions.exact_action: Type the desired location number into the location field.

stop_or_escalate_if: If no rack/AGV location is shown for the entered number, stop and escalate rather than continuing to guess.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/transcript: “You can also find a tote by typing the location number in and selecting the rack or AGV it’s located on if it’s in the system.”

steps.title: Select the rack or AGV where the tote is located (if it is in the system)
steps.purpose: Confirm the tote’s location by selecting the rack/AGV identified by the screen for the entered location number.
steps.instruction: Select the rack or AGV where the tote is located as shown by the Container Selection screen for the entered location number (when it exists in the system).
steps.expected_result: The screen identifies the rack or AGV where the tote is located for the entered location number (when it exists in the system).
steps.healthy_condition: A rack/AGV location associated with the entered location number is shown/selected on the Container Selection screen.
steps.failure_condition: The screen does not show a rack/AGV location for the entered number.

actions.label: Select rack/AGV
actions.exact_action: Select the rack or AGV where it’s located on if it’s in the system.

stop_or_escalate_if: If no rack/AGV location is shown for the entered number, stop and escalate rather than continuing to guess.

steps.healthy_condition: After entering the tote number, the screen can present rack/AGV location information for that tote (when it exists).
steps.failure_condition: No rack/AGV location is shown for the entered tote number.

stop_or_escalate_if: If no rack/AGV location is shown for the entered number, stop and escalate rather than continuing to guess.
